    § 02 · The Method

    Designed to train, test, and transform.

    CONVOY is built on the conviction that logistics fluency is a strategic capability — not a back-office footnote. Every module pairs business-English precision with operational judgment, supply chain literacy, and the professional clarity that defines premium logistics leaders.

    01

    Premium Curriculum

    One hundred modules covering every domain of modern logistics — from the foundations of warehousing and transportation to AI-powered supply chains and autonomous delivery.

    02

    Realistic Scenarios

    Every MCQ is rooted in plausible professional situations — carrier negotiations, route planning, customs clearance, warehouse audits — written for international logistics professionals.

    03

    Automatic Grading

    Instant scoring with tiered performance feedback — from foundational to executive fluency — plus the vocabulary and strategic insight earned from each module.

    04

    Progress That Tracks

    Your completion and scores are tracked live as you move through the program. Revisit your strongest topics anytime in this session, or retake a module to refine your fluency.

    § 03 · The Author

    Brice Gadou

    Business English Expert

    Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for international professionals. CONVOY reflects his vision: logistics fluency as strategic capability — a multiplier of trust, clarity, and operational credibility.

    Designed for the logistics coordinators, operations leads, and supply chain leaders shaping how the world's goods actually move — CONVOY is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to communicate in the discipline most responsible for making sure everything arrives.
